In this video, we explore how the same ideas that made AI models smarter over the last few years can also help humans think and learn better. Using the evolution of large language models as a reference point, we talk about things like reasoning, learning through feedback, using tools properly, recognizing patterns, and adapting to new situations. The idea is simple: intelligence is not just talent, it’s something that can be trained and improved deliberately over time.

We then go through practical ideas around thinking clearly, learning faster, building judgment, teaching others, and becoming more adaptable. The conversation touches on mentorship, creativity, decision-making under pressure, multimodal learning, and why people who can combine different skills and perspectives tend to do better in the long run.
